_context.settings.scopeTitle: Heading of the list of notification scopes (what you get notified about).
_context.settings.modes.default.yourSetting: Hint under the Default option of a coworker's bell menu. {scope} is the label of the user's global scope, already translated.
_context.settings.modes.everything.label: Per-coworker notification mode: notified of every run of this coworker.
_context.settings.bell.title: {name} is a coworker's name.
_context.settings.bell.scheduled: {count} is the number of scheduled tasks of the coworker.
_context.settings.channels.title: Heading of the notification channels (toast, sound, email): how you are notified.
_context.settings.channels.toast.label: A toast is the small popup notification in the app.
_context.inbox.rowMenu.unfollow: Menu item on a coworker's inbox row.
_context.inbox.detail.seeAllCount: Button that opens the whole inbox. {count} is how many items it holds.
_context.inbox.markAll.label: Label of the button that opens the menu below.
_context.inbox.markAll.markRead: Menu item: marks the notifications that only inform. {count} is how many of them there are.
_context.inbox.markAll.clearAll: Menu item: empties the inbox. {count} is how many requests still wait for an answer among what leaves.
_context.inbox.markAll.confirmDescription: {count} is how many requests still wait for an answer.
_context.inbox.detail.status.awaiting_ack: Kind of a notification: something a coworker flagged that the user has not read yet.
_context.notices: Notices the app sends the whole workspace (in-app and by email) about a paid app (LinkedIn Pro, WhatsApp Pro) or the credits. {provider} is LinkedIn or WhatsApp, {account} the name of the connected account. Settings → Apps names a screen of the app.
_context.notices.trialEndsSoon: {endsAt} is the day the free slot ends.
_context.toast.coworker: Title of a notification from a coworker whose name is not known.
_context.toast.scheduledTask: Title of a notification from a scheduled run. {name} is the coworker.
_context.inbox.reasons: Line under a notification row: why it reached the user. {agentName} is a coworker.

notices.rateLimited: {provider} asked {account, select, none {one of your accounts} other {{account}}} to slow down. Your coworkers will not use it for 24 hours, so the account stays safe.
notices.signedOut: {provider} signed {account, select, none {one of your accounts} other {{account}}} out. Reconnect it from Settings → Apps so your coworkers can use it again.
notices.budgetExhausted: Your {brand} credits for this month are used up. Scheduled and triggered runs on {brand} models are paused, and coworkers cannot buy leads, SEO or social data, until they reset or you add credits.
